title: How do online occupational therapy sessions work?
metaTitle: Online Occupational Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how online occupational therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network maintain continuity in your child's therapy journey irrespective of your location.
html: We, at Pinnacle Blooms, have leveraged technology to ensure that all children have access to the therapy they need irrespective of physical constraints. With online occupational therapy sessions, you get the same level of dedication and interaction as face-to-face sessions. Our expert therapists guide and watch over your child's activities via a secure platform, providing instant feedback, and improvements. Not only that, but we also record sessions for further reference and continuous monitoring of your child's progress. This ensures we are with your child every step of the way, no matter where you are.
